answer_1.quote: Conditional text generation encompasses a large number of natural language processing tasks such as text simplification, summarization, machine translation and style transfer ... We evaluate on two style transfer tasks for English. On text simplification ... we report BLEU and SARI.
answer_1.outputs: Generated sentences (e.g., simplified sentences or sentiment‑transferred sentences).

answer_2.quote: We report two scores: BLEU, which correlates with grammaticality, and SARI, found to correlate well with human judgements of simplicity. ... We also evaluate transfer accuracy with a DistilBERT classifier and self‑BLEU for content preservation.
